title: Concept: Predictable randomness via Math.random (java) — review required
description: In java, Math.random is a statistical generator, not a cryptographic one: observing outputs reveals the state, and default seeds repeat across runs. Security values need unpredictability, which only SecureRandom provides in java.
applicability: java codebases drawing random values through Math.random; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Guessed session tokens, reset links, and nonces when predictable output guards access; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when the value directly authenticates.
